m101-pets.observed_description: A family garden at a party with balloons and a long table behind: a tan dog trotting across the lawn, a ginger-and-white cat asleep on a chair cushion, a white rabbit eating a lettuce leaf, and a small bird at the rim of a stone bird bath with its head down to the water. No people.
m101-pets.note: Usable in 3:2 (declared 3:2 only). Every target is plain at phone size and nothing readable is written in the photo. The bird is small, so its target covers the whole bird bath.
